#!/bin/bash
cd /bench/repo

# Check each function
for func in "ValidateEmail" "GenUUID" "HasPrefixes" "ConvertStringToInt32" "ReplaceString" "NewEngine" "DefaultEngine" "NewSchema" "AppendConditions" "NewMarkdownRenderer" "DetectJPEG" "ExtractVideo" "ValidateURL" "GetHTMLMeta" "GetImage" "Post" "PostAsync" "Send" "SendAsync" "NewService" "ParseCronExpression" "DefaultTranscriptionModel" "FindProvider"; do

  count=$(rg "$func\(" --type go --count-matches | awk '{s+=$1} END {print s}')
  
  # Try to find definition file
  deffile=$(rg "^func \(.*\)?$func\(" --type go -l | grep -v test | head -1)
  
  echo "$func: ~$count calls (defined in $(basename $deffile 2>/dev/null || echo 'unknown'))"
done | sort -t: -k2 -rn | head -20
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/count_calls.sh
bash /tmp/count_calls.sh

# For each function, count non-test calls (excluding the definition itself)

  def_line=$(grep -r "^func.*$func(" internal/ --include="*.go" | grep -v test | head -1)
